Perfect. After e7 Rxg6+ Bxg6 Kxe7, White is left with just a bishop, but White has eliminated Black's rook entirely. This is clearly winning for White.

**Coaching note:** Your rook was pinned to the king by White's g6 pawn. When White pushed e7, you had to capture it (or allow e8=Q), which gave White a free exchange—your rook for the pawn. Always watch for loose pieces that can't defend themselves when passed pawns advance, and spot when your own pieces are boxed in.
